Levels.ANG: Presentation of a target anger story

valence.Description: Valence rating associated with a trial
valence.Units: Points on a scale, where: 0 - Negative emotions, 5 - No emotions, 10 - Positive emotions

arousal.Description: Arousal rating associated with a trial
arousal.Units: Points on a scale, where: 0 - Low arousal, 10 - High arousal
